Declines the $27 VIP → a second paid offer

The decline path is monetised. Saying no to VIP routes to a separate replay-access offer, and only after declining that does the confirmation page appear. Two chances to convert on the highest-intent moment in the funnel.

VERIFIED · walked both decline paths 31 Jul
“I have no followers” → pre-approved accounts

She concedes TikTok's real 5,000-follower rule plainly, then reveals a “cheat code”: access to pre-approved accounts that already clear it, “ethically and safely”. The concession is what makes the reveal credible. Flag: account transfer sits against TikTok's terms. Copy the persuasion structure, not the mechanic.

VERIFIED · transcript of “Do I need followers”
“What's my risk?” → risk is inaction

“The real risk is not the program. The real risk is hesitating while one of the biggest opportunities in social media history is happening right in front of us.” She never defends price. She moves the risk onto standing still.

VERIFIED · transcript, 99-second answer
“How fast will I earn?” → no number given

“How much money will you make in 90 days? It's impossible to tell.” Then three process promises: confidence with the platform, first commissions in 60–90 days, and a durable skill. Legally clean and more believable than a figure.
